OPEN INTERFACE COMMONS

Tessellate for agents

Use the same resource vocabulary and validated manifests as human editors.

Discover the catalogue

Read /data/catalog.json for canonical resource IDs, semantic roles, constraints, dependencies, provenance and licences. Registry JSON at /r/[slug].json contains installable source.

Compose and mutate

The repository CLI and MCP packages compose deterministic manifests and validate mutations against canonical Zod schemas. Read the integration documentation before automating changes.

Review capability boundary

The public site serves discovery files and browser workflows. It does not run a hosted MCP process or present unconfigured API endpoints as functional services.
